BiblicalUsage: God's judgments open the story of the Exodus: He tells Moses He will redeem Israel with great judgments, and then He executes judgment on the gods of Egypt. The same word follows kings and scorners through the rest of the Bible, because judgment is what God does when He settles a matter.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe judgment is not God losing His temper; it is God putting things right. He judged Egypt to free His people, and He will judge every proud thing the same way, so I would rather be on the side of those He delivers than those He judges.
